finding: Concurrent secret reads returned EOF; the destination CDS logged matching TLS handshake read timeouts. Its five-second handshake budget expired while the client-side attestation service was busy generating TDX quotes. The pinned attester calls blocking ConfigFS/vsock I/O directly on async workers. This is evidence of an attestation scheduling bottleneck; no partition or rolling-upgrade result is claimed.
follow_up: Move TDX hardware quote generation to a single bounded actor thread, preserving quote validation and CDS workload/timeouts. Requalify the changed measured images locally and on the same three workers.
